package proto

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
	"runtime/metrics"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func readPauseHist() *metrics.Float64Histogram {
	s := []metrics.Sample{{Name: "/sched/pauses/stopping/gc:seconds"}}
	metrics.Read(s)
	return s[0].Value.Float64Histogram()
}

// percentiles from a histogram delta (buckets are upper bounds in seconds).
func pct(before, after *metrics.Float64Histogram, ps ...float64) []float64 {
	var total uint64
	counts := make([]uint64, len(after.Counts))
	for i := range after.Counts {
		d := after.Counts[i]
		if i < len(before.Counts) {
			d -= before.Counts[i]
		}
		counts[i] = d
		total += d
	}
	out := make([]float64, len(ps))
	for k, p := range ps {
		target := uint64(float64(total) * p)
		var cum uint64
		for i, c := range counts {
			cum += c
			if cum >= target {
				out[k] = after.Buckets[i+1]
				break
			}
		}
	}
	return out
}

// Item 3: GC stops a loop that calls nothing but the back-edge poll.
func TestGCStopsSpinLoop(t *testing.T) {
	interruptRequested.Store(0)
	before := readPauseHist()
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	stop := make(chan struct{})
	n := runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0) - 1; if n < 1 { n = 1 }; for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			for {
				select {
				case <-stop:
					return
				default:
					spin(0, 20_000_000)
				}
			}
		}()
	}
	gcDone := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		for i := 0; i < 200; i++ {
			runtime.GC()
		}
		close(gcDone)
	}()
	<-gcDone // if GC could not stop the spinning goroutines, this blocks forever
	close(stop)
	wg.Wait()
	after := readPauseHist()
	p := pct(before, after, 0.50, 0.99, 1.0)
	fmt.Printf("GC-STOP pauses over 200 forced GCs, GOMAXPROCS-1 spinners: P50=%.1fµs P99=%.1fµs max=%.1fµs\n",
	fmt.Printf("  host_poll calls during run: %d\n", pollCount.Load())
		p[0]*1e6, p[1]*1e6, p[2]*1e6)
}

// Item 6: an interrupt requested during the loop is observed at the poll and
// the loop terminates early.
func TestInterruptLatched(t *testing.T) {
	interruptRequested.Store(0)
	interruptLatched.Store(0)
	done := make(chan int64, 1)
	go func() { done <- spin(0, 5_000_000_000) }()
	time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	interruptRequested.Store(1)
	select {
	case <-done:
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("spin did not terminate after interrupt")
	}
	if interruptLatched.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("interrupt was not latched at the poll")
	}
	interruptRequested.Store(0)
}
